scope: offscreen QML with fake ViewModel/controller ports

cases.title: start opens consent or emits start after trusted state
unchecked consent disables authorize and cancel is a no-op
checked consent emits authorize true and closes dialog
stop emits stop and clears recommendation state
floating window shows once and repeated requests do not duplicate it
floating close synchronizes hidden state and can reopen
candidate toggle expands and collapses without changing data
model file dialog opens, cancel is a no-op, selection emits path
